title: Meeting people
learner_outcome: Introduce yourself in a short guided exchange by stating your name and where you are from.

skills.description: Introduce yourself using your name and origin.

required_evidence: Produce an introduction containing both the learner's name and origin.
Complete a short guided introduction exchange.
lesson_scope: Asking and answering a person's name.
pronunciation_scope: Clear production of I am and I am from.
Listening comparison with en-US and en-GB references.
Voice recording is practice evidence, not automatic proof of pronunciation accuracy.
content_constraints: Use only language appropriate for A1.
Keep learner responses short and reusable.
Do not introduce unrelated topics such as mood, work or detailed personal information.
Every required phrase must appear in meaningful context.
Do not declare the Skill complete through a recognition-only multiple-choice exercise.
technical_constraints: Use LessonExperience as the v2 pedagogical orchestrator.
Keep the candidate isolated from content_tree.json.
Preserve stable existing identifiers only when their pedagogical meaning remains valid.
Do not modify Flutter, progress persistence or active content during candidate construction.
Completing the pilot lesson must not automatically declare the Skill mastered or retained.
acceptance_criteria: The learner states both a name and an origin.
The learner completes an applied guided conversation.
The required evidence is linked to the Skill.
Every required Skill stage has an explicit activity or evidence reference.
The candidate passes all deterministic backend validations.
Coverage remains pending_approval until human pedagogical review.
The candidate distinguishes lesson completion from Skill mastery and retention.
